card.name: Linking words after stimulant drug names
card.fires_on: Responds to 'and' or 'including' right after a stimulant drug name such as phentermine or amphetamine, just before the next drug is named. It also fires on a few odd spots, such as 'mg' in a combination dose.

modes.label: 'and' in phentermine and topiramate
modes.description: The word 'and' joining phentermine to topiramate in the combination capsule name.

modes.label: 'including' after stimulants
modes.description: The word 'including' after 'stimulants' or 'CNS stimulants', before a named drug.
modes.example: WARNING: ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE CNS stimulants,<< including>> Dexmethylphenidate Hydrochlor

modes.label: Dose unit or drug-name start
modes.description: A dose unit 'mg' in a combination dose, or the first letter of methylphenidate.
